sources.title: Cycles on abelian 2n-folds of Weil type from secant sheaves on abelian n-folds

sources.title: Discriminants of Hermitian forms, maximal degenerations and Kontsevich's tropical approach to the Hodge conjecture

sources.title: Relative Secant Cycles and Hodge Classes
sources.status: Not used as a valid theorem
sources.specific_problem: Section 4.3 identifies Weil classes with the Norm^n eigenspace and puts the polarization power in the invariant eigenspace. For n=3 and a=2+i, the exact calculation instead gives Weil eigenvalues -117 +/- 44i and polarization-cube eigenvalue 125=Norm(a)^3. Thus that identification is false with the stated pullback action. This is a specific source-level failure, not a full audit of the preprint.
